svg.text: Court service box · continuous field below retained W1/W2
Schematic, not to scale. One 840 mm length of a continuous wrap; no gas, water, structural or site acceptance.
RED = proposed field below outside of box, not W2; ends/corners and pier interfaces not drawn.
1003 mm total box width; an 840 mm length has 1.609 m² bottom plus sides, ≈12.63 kg at 1 mm.
W1 lid/renewal stays above sheet; seal, W2 drainage and independent A/G duty remain separate.
DPC/structural piers, sheet support, friction separation, site pressure, weld access, movement and repair are HOLDS.
A line or this mass sensitivity does not prove a continuous ground-gas or waterproof assembly.
